value.rationale: An exact, natural finite-geometry invariant of all smooth plane cubics at the first 3-divisible cardinality supporting the two possible 2-primary structures (12), not merely a single numerical example. The theorem distinguishes four versus five lines by both rational 2-torsion and the embedding-dependent rational-flex condition; the two outcomes occur over the same field F11. This resolves precisely a finite-size phenomenon left logically open by asymptotic line-cover bounds. It is a complete classification at a motivated minimal threshold, not a normalization check.
